description: This file defines a template class VectorSetSorter used for efficiently sorting, de-duplicating, and iterating over sets of items of type T. It provides methods to add items, iterate with a callback, and retrieve a sorted vector of items.

classes.name: VectorSetSorter
classes.description: A template class for sorting and de-duplicating sets of items of type T, with methods for adding items, iterating, and converting to vector.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a single item or a range of items to the sorter, marking the internal state as unsorted.

methods.name: IterateOver
methods.description: Iterates over sorted, de-duplicated items, invoking a callback for each.

methods.name: AsVector
methods.description: Returns a vector of sorted, de-duplicated items, copying the data.

methods.name: Sort
methods.description: Sorts the internal list of item pointers, removing duplicates.
